classification.difficultyReason: Find one part from a known route section, then calculate the combined distance represented by seven parts.

inlines.text: The ratio of the distance between Marble Cliff and Stone Lake to the distance between Stone Lake and Glacier Forest is
The distance between Marble Cliff and Stone Lake is 21 km.
Find the distance between Marble Cliff and Glacier Forest.

answer.worked:
The distance from Marble Cliff to Stone Lake represents 3 parts.
$$\begin{align*}3\text{ parts}&=21\text{ km}\\1\text{ part}&=21\div3=7\text{ km}\\\text{Total parts}&=3+4=7\\7\text{ parts}&=7\times7=49\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
The distance between Marble Cliff and Glacier Forest is $49\text{ km}$.
